cosmoteer.corridor.description_en: A hallway through which crew quickly travel.

cosmoteer.laser_blaster_small.description_en: A highly accurate and versatile weapon that fires single blasts of energy, dealing moderate damage to enemy ships.

cosmoteer.laser_blaster_large.description_en: Pairs together two large laser guns on a single turret, which combine for much higher damage at the expense of some accuracy and versatility.

cosmoteer.disruptor.description_en: Fires bolts of electrical energy that deal little damage but can short-circuit enemy systems, causing them to lose power. Can penetrate shields while draining them.

cosmoteer.ion_beam_emitter.description_en: Shoots a powerful beam of ion energy in a fixed direction. Damage is lower at longer range. Can be shot into an Ion Beam Prism to redirect its angle.

cosmoteer.ion_beam_prism.description_en: Redirects the angles of incoming ion beams, aiming them at enemy ships or other Ion Beam Prisms.

cosmoteer.resonance_beam_turret.description_en: A roof-mounted turret that fires a beam of pure heat energy but also produces a great deal of its own waste heat. Weakens shields around the impact point.

cosmoteer.thermal_dilation_pump.description_en: Increases the heat area-of-effect for all Thermal Resonance Lances connected to the same thermal network. Both of the pump's ports must be connected to achieve full effect.

cosmoteer.thermal_amplification_pump.description_en: Increases the heat intensity for all Thermal Resonance Lances connected to the same thermal network.

cosmoteer.cannon_med.description_en: Fires single rounds of projectile ammunition that can penetrate into enemy ships, sometimes starting fires.

cosmoteer.cannon_large.description_en: Fuses together four rounds of projectile ammunition to greatly enhance damage and penetration depth compared to the Standard Cannon.

cosmoteer.cannon_deck.description_en: A huge double-barreled cannon that is mounted on top of the ship instead of the side for extra stability. Each barrel fuses together ten rounds of projectile ammunition and is so loud that it briefly stuns nearby crew.

cosmoteer.missile_launcher.description_en: Launches missiles or mines of any type.  The type of munition launched can be changed at any time during or after construction, even during battle.

cosmoteer.railgun_launcher.description_en: A required component of all railguns. Must be paired with a Loader and zero or more Accelerators.

cosmoteer.railgun_accelerator.description_en: An optional component placed between a railgun's Launcher and Loader. Each accelerator increases the projectile's velocity, damage, and penetration depth.

cosmoteer.railgun_loader.description_en: A required component of all railguns. Must be paired with a Launcher and zero or more Accelerators.

cosmoteer.chaingun.description_en: A powerful rotary cannon that increases its rate of fire the longer it shoots and hides behind a protective shell while not shooting. Additional ammunition magazines can be attached to increase its duration and rate of fire.

cosmoteer.chaingun_magazine.description_en: An extra ammunition storage for the Chaingun, increasing its duration and rate of fire. Must be attached to the lower left or right sides of the chaingun.

cosmoteer.shield_gen_small.description_en: Projects a small defensive energy shield in an arc outside the ship, blocking most incoming fire. Vulnerable to Disruptors and EMPs.

cosmoteer.shield_gen_large.description_en: Projects a large defensive energy shield in an arc outside the ship, blocking most incoming fire. Vulnerable to Disruptors and EMPs.

cosmoteer.flak_cannon_large.description_en: A powerful defensive system that can destroy enemy missiles, lasers, and projectiles. Can also inflict moderate damage to enemy ships.

cosmoteer.point_defense.description_en: An automated defensive system that shoots down enemy missiles and projectiles using super-heated plasma rounds. Can also inflict light damage to enemy ships.

cosmoteer.armor.description_en: Absorbs a great deal of enemy weapons fire, protecting a ship's juicy innards. Also acts as a "lightning rod" for E.M.P. effects.

cosmoteer.thruster_small.description_en: A weak propulsion engine used mainly for maneuvering. Contains a small dynamo that slowly regenerates power.

cosmoteer.thruster_small_2way.description_en: A weak, bi-directional propulsion engine used mainly for maneuvering. Contains a small dynamo that slowly regenerates power.

cosmoteer.thruster_small_3way.description_en: A weak, tri-directional propulsion engine used mainly for maneuvering. Contains a small dynamo that slowly regenerates power.

cosmoteer.thruster_med.description_en: A standard-sized propulsion engine capable of pushing the ship with a modest amount of force. Requires a short time to achieve full thrust.

cosmoteer.thruster_large.description_en: A double-sized propulsion engine capable of pushing the ship with more than twice the force of the Standard Thruster. Requires a medium amount of time to achieve full thrust.

cosmoteer.thruster_huge.description_en: A huge propulsion engine capable of pushing the ship with more than twice the force of the Large Thruster. Requires a long time to achieve full thrust.

cosmoteer.thruster_boost.description_en: A variant of the Large Thruster that can inject raw plasma directly into its combustors for a powerful but short-lived boost. Power cannot be delivered while boosting.

cosmoteer.thruster_rocket_nozzle.description_en: A required component of all Modular Rocket Thrusters. May be combined with zero or more Extender modules and up to two Fuel Pods per Nozzle or Extender.

cosmoteer.thruster_rocket_extender.description_en: An optional component placed behind a Modular Rocket Thruster's Nozzle or other Extender. Each extender increases its maximum thrust, power usage, and ramp-up time. Battery fuel capacity may be extended with up to two Fuel Pods.

cosmoteer.thruster_rocket_battery.description_en: Extends the battery fuel capacity of an attached M.R.T. Nozzle or Extender by four batteries.

cosmoteer.engine_room.description_en: Increases the thrust and power usage of adjacent thrusters by 50%. Also acts as a central delivery point for adjacent thrusters to which crew can deliver batteries without having to travel to each one individually.

cosmoteer.control_room_small.description_en: Allows the ship to fly and coordinate its weapons by providing <good>+50<image name='command_points' colored='true'/></good> Command Points.

cosmoteer.control_room_med.description_en: Allows the ship to fly and coordinate its weapons by providing <good>+250<image name='command_points' colored='true'/></good> Command Points.

cosmoteer.control_room_large.description_en: Allows the ship to fly and coordinate its weapons by providing <good>+1000<image name='command_points' colored='true'/></good> Command Points.

cosmoteer.hyperdrive_small.description_en: Allows the ship to instantaneously travel to other destinations within the solar system, to friendly ships with Hyperdrive Beacons, or when assisted by a Hyper-Jump Relay, to other solar systems.

cosmoteer.hyperdrive_med.description_en: Allows the ship to instantaneously travel to other destinations within the solar system, to friendly ships with Hyperdrive Beacons, or when assisted by a Hyper-Jump Relay, to other solar systems.

cosmoteer.hyperdrive_large.description_en: Allows the ship to instantaneously travel to other destinations within the solar system, to friendly ships with Hyperdrive Beacons, or when assisted by a Hyper-Jump Relay, to other solar systems.

cosmoteer.airlock.description_en: Allows crew to enter and exit the ship, such as to pick up resources or transfer between ships.

cosmoteer.conveyor.description_en: Allows crew to travel faster, but only in one direction.

cosmoteer.reactor_small.description_en: A power generator that produces the plasma batteries needed to power many of the ship's systems.

cosmoteer.reactor_med.description_en: A power generator that produces double-capacity plasma batteries needed to power many of the ship's systems.

cosmoteer.reactor_large.description_en: A power generator that produces triple-capacity plasma batteries needed to power many of the ship's systems.

cosmoteer.power_storage.description_en: Stores a limited cache of plasma batteries that may be delivered by crew to nearby ship's systems.

cosmoteer.heat_pipe_adaptive.description_en: Instantaneously transfers thermal energy between connected parts.

cosmoteer.heat_pipe_crossing.description_en: <string id='Parts/HeatPipeAdaptiveDesc'/> Allows crew to walk underneath the pipe.

cosmoteer.radiator.description_en: Dissipates heat from the connected thermal network. Dissipation effectiveness is reduced if the area in front of the radiator is blocked.

cosmoteer.thermal_battery.description_en: Safely contains large amounts of thermal energy, providing additional heat storage to the connected thermal network.

cosmoteer.heat_exchanger.description_en: Absorbs heat from the hull, transferring it to the connected thermal network while generating some additional waste heat.

cosmoteer.factory_ammo.description_en: Manufactures projectile ammunition used by cannons and railguns. Consumes sulfur. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_he.description_en: Manufactures guided High-Explosive missiles that cause significant damage over a small area. Consumes iron and sulfur. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_emp.description_en: Manufactures guided Electromagnetic Pulse missiles that drain power from enemy systems in a very large area. Consumes iron and copper. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_thermal.description_en: Manufactures guided Thermal Canister Missiles that take thermal energy from their own ship's heat pipe network and inflict it upon the target in a small area of effect. Consumes copper and sulfur. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_nuke.description_en: Manufactures Tactical Nuclear Missiles that cause massive damage in a very large area. Consumes iron and uranium. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_mine.description_en: Manufactures mines that explode when in proximity to enemy ships, launching damaging shrapnel. Consumes iron and ammo. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_steel.description_en: Manufactures steel plates, which are used to construct almost all ship parts. Consumes iron. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_coil.description_en: Manufactures coils, which are used to construct many ship parts. Consumes copper. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_coil2.description_en: Manufactures hyper-coils, which are used to construct many advanced ship parts. Consumes copper and coils. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_tristeel.description_en: Manufactures Tri-Steel plates, which are used to construct some advanced ship parts. Consumes tritanium. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_diamond.description_en: Manufactures diamonds, which are used to construct some advanced ship parts. Consumes carbon.

cosmoteer.factory_processor.description_en: Manufactures processors, which are used to construct some advanced ship parts. Consumes gold and coils. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.factory_uranium.description_en: Enriches uranium, which is needed to construct reactors and other advanced ship parts. Consumes unenriched uranium. Gains +25% production speed for each adjacent factory of any type.

cosmoteer.storage_2x2.description_en: Stores 4 stacks of resources of any types.

cosmoteer.storage_3x2.description_en: Stores 6 stacks of resources of any types.

cosmoteer.storage_3x3.description_en: Stores 9 stacks of resources of any types.

cosmoteer.storage_4x3.description_en: Stores 12 stacks of resources of any types.

cosmoteer.storage_4x4.description_en: Stores 16 stacks of resources of any types.

cosmoteer.fire_extinguisher.description_en: Stores a fire extinguisher that crew can use to put out fires. Fire extinguishers have a limited capacity but a new one will be constructed out of thin air every 15 seconds.

cosmoteer.mining_laser_small.description_en: A pair of roof-mounted precision laser beams that can quickly extract resources from even the toughest asteroids. Also effective at salvaging ships, and in a pinch can be used as a short-range weapon.

cosmoteer.manipulator_beam_emitter.description_en: Projects up to 16 small, roof-mounted tractor beams that can collect resources and boost flying crew. A single crew can control up to four beams, and they will only go to the Manipulator Beam Emitter when there are tasks to help with.

cosmoteer.tractor_beam_emitter.description_en: Emits a gravitation beam that pulls and pushes ships and other large objects.

cosmoteer.sensor_array.description_en: Extends the sensor range of your ship. (Does not stack with other sensor arrays.)

cosmoteer.hyperdrive_beacon.description_en: Ships with Hyperdrives can jump to ships with Hyperdrive Beacons.

cosmoteer.explosive_charge.description_en: A small explosive device that can be manually detonated. Primarily used for deliberately splitting ships into multiple pieces.

cosmoteer.roof_light.description_en: A small exterior light. Provides no practical benefit.

cosmoteer.roof_headlight.description_en: An exterior headlight that can be aimed. Provides no practical benefit.

cosmoteer.structure.description_en: The underlying structural frame that holds a ship together. Structure is automatically included with all rooms and corridors.
